items.heading: Saltenas
details: Key ingredients: pastry dough, beef or chicken, potato, peas, gelatin broth
Cook a stew of meat, potato and peas with a gelatin-set broth, then chill until firm.
Fill pastry dough rounds with the chilled stew filling.
Fold and crimp the edges into a rope pattern, sealing tightly.
Bake until the pastry is golden; the filling turns juicy again as it bakes.

items.heading: Pique a lo Macho
details: Key ingredients: beef, sausage, fries, onion, tomato, chili
Fry thick-cut potato wedges until crisp.
Grill or fry strips of beef and sliced sausage.
Toss the meats with sauteed onion, tomato and chili over the fries.
Serve piled high on a platter, family style.
